description: A role that may read every row removes the scope

output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM `report` AS `report_view`

SELECT
  `report_view`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `report_view`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `report_view`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `report_view`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`report_view`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `report_view`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `report_view`.`v` AS `v`
FROM `report` AS `report_view` ORDER BY `report_view`.`id` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
